Asset type: one complete transparent tactical animation master of the named heroine Mirelle, matching the approved idle.

Preserve the actual muted linked-square hem with central diamond and the brown ledger's small angular marks without adding emblems. Keep her large head, broad glove/boot shapes and broad matte cel planes. No costume redesign, texture detail increase, new ornament or shiny material.
HANDS AND GEAR LOCK: anatomical RIGHT arm is near/image-left and holds the same thick brown name ledger; anatomical LEFT hand is image-right and holds the same bronze lantern by its ring. One ledger and one lantern only. Preserve their physical sizes, rectangular enclosed lantern body, crossed mullions and contained amber flame. No staff pole, shovel, sword or separate spell effects. Light is inside the lantern only.
CANVAS AND CAMERA LOCK: same landscape native 1585×992 pixels as reference, unchanged body scale and elevated three-quarter east-facing camera. Head size/height and body volume remain stable, hood crown about y47 and ordinary stance baseline around y967. Do not fit or shrink the figure to equipment. POSE: ATTACK/CAST, one clear active lantern-forward spell action toward image-right. Mirelle braces her two broad boots in a strong slightly wider stance and leans forward a little, keeping her mature face and hood size unchanged. Her LEFT arm (image-right) reaches forward decisively, holding the original lantern by its ring in front of her at roughly chest/waist height; show a clear extended elbow and one hand naturally gripping the ring. The intact lantern remains upright, with the same physical size as idle and its flame wholly contained inside the metal/glass cage. Her RIGHT arm/image-left retains the closed name ledger close against her ribs, one gloved hand supporting it. Do not let the book disappear, duplicate or change hands. Clear intent comes from braced legs, forward arm and focused face, not glow. No beam, aura, flames outside the lantern, rune cloud or projectile. Two hands and two boots only, no extra forearm. Keep enough right margin for the lantern within the full canvas.
